summary: The AssessmentSection documents provide structured information on managing and retrieving assessment section data within the HSPnet system. It involves database operations for fetching, listing, and interacting with assessment sections using stored procedures.
purpose: To manage assessment sections related to placement requests, including retrieving, listing, and ensuring proper database interactions for managing assessment data.

fields.name: TemplateCodeID
fields.description: Identifier for the template code related to the section.

fields.name: AssessmentHeaderID
fields.description: Identifier for the assessment header associated with the section.

fields.name: SectionNameAlt
fields.description: Alternate name for the assessment section.

fields.name: SectionTitleAlt
fields.description: Alternate title for the assessment section.

fields.name: SectionSubHeadingAlt
fields.description: Alternate sub-heading for the assessment section.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order in which sections are sorted.

fields.name: AppliedAssessorTypeCodeID
fields.description: Code identifier for the type of assessor applied.

fields.name: AppliedAssessmentTypeCodeID
fields.description: Code identifier for the type of assessment applied.

fields.name: AssessAssessmentSubjectCodeID
fields.description: Code identifier for the subject of the assessment.

fields.name: RequiredAnswerMissing
fields.description: Indicates if a required answer is missing.

fields.name: HasQuestion
fields.description: Indicates if the section has a question.

fields.name: Optional
fields.description: Indicates if the section is optional.

workflows.name: Retrieve Assessment Sections
steps: Execute stored procedure and read results.

workflows.name: Search Assessment Section by Template
steps: Execute stored procedure and read results.

business_rules: Assessment sections must have unique IDs.
Sections can be optional or required.
validations: Check if required answers are missing.
system_behavior: Fetches and processes assessment section data using defined stored procedures.
Supports alternate section names and titles based on locale.
dependencies: SQL Server for stored procedure execution.
